prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: seamless PBR base-colour texture for broken old brick fragments on a low-tide harbour bank in a realistic game.
A flat orthographic cross-polarized photographic scan of the fractured interior of one continuous piece of old dense fired red-brown clay, filling the entire square image. The image represents 30 cm by 30 cm of material. Fine irregular pores, tiny dark mineral inclusions and a few subtle pale sand grains under 1 mm. Muted earthy russet, umber and grey-brown firing variation, never bright orange or saturated red. Compact weathered ceramic surface with worn micro-pitting. Low contrast but convincing real mineral detail.
Perfectly even neutral illumination, base colour only, no cast shadows, glossy highlights, baked occlusion or object shading. Seamless across all four edges.
No brick outlines, mortar, block joins, edges, large cracks, stacked objects, rubble, stones, moss, sand bed, lettering, logos, borders or watermark. Not sandstone, polished marble, leather or wood grain. No diagonal striations or large repetitive structures. Opaque square texture.
